newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Gunmen kill Somali faction official.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Somali faction official.

text.p: Three unidentified gunmen shot dead a Somali militia official at his house in Mogadishu on Sunday, witnesses said.

News of the assassination of Abdi Ashir Korir, assistant secretary for information in the faction led by Osman Ali Atto quickly spread through Mogadishu, raising fears of a new outbreak of inter-faction fighting in the capital.
There were no further details on the killing.
Somalia has had no effective government since president Mohamed Siad Barre was ousted in January 1991. Rival groups now control different areas of the country.
